description: Figure 3 is a pie chart showing the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval‑GenSearch test set across 12 categories (12 slices total). The slices are labeled around the chart with percentages and are colored distinctly (various blues, teals, oranges, yellows, and reds), with no slice exploded or otherwise emphasized; there is no separate legend because labels are placed directly next to slices. The labeled slices are: AI/NLP Research (blue) at about 24.3%, Econ. & Fin. (teal) at about 18.4%, Game&Anime (orange) at about 8.2%, Daily Life (light blue) at about 7.1%, Science (light purple) at about 6.7%, Med & Health (green) at about 6.7%, Business (gray) at about 5.9%, Law (pink) at about 5.1%, History (yellow) at about 8.2%, Geography (light green) at about 2.7%, Math (tan) at about 1.4%, and Pet & Animal (peach) at about 5.5%. The segments do not appear to be arranged in a strictly descending order by size.
